frame.stacking: not stackable: a stepped ground store whose arrows stand above the frame (to ~1.9 m).

space.unity: prefab space, origin on the floor at the centre of the footprint, +z front, +y up, +x to the furniture's left seen from the front

groups.0-6: front row (lowest step), left to right seen from the front: ordinary arrows; tube 6 is a spare
groups.7-12: middle row: fire, surtling fire, poison, frost, silver, needle
groups.13-19: back row (highest step): carapace, chitin, charred, green metal, ancient; tubes 18 and 19 are spares
groups.rule: one arrow kind per tube (unit 'item' = the kind; the 3 spare tubes have no item and take any other arrow in a ByGroup store). Units are listed tube by tube, 4 per tube, in fill order.

band_spare: hemp rope (unpainted) on the 3 spare tubes
fill_order: each tube's 4 units (bundles) in order: opposite pairs (a half-full tube is balanced); each is one stack of 13 arrows.
position: unit position = mean of its copies' feet, on the floor of its tube (the tube head, deck + 0.07). box = [x, y, z] Unity, informational.
copy_rule: align (long axis -> up, thin axis -> x), then_rotate = a lean of 1-4 degrees times a spin about the shaft, fit_longest_m 0.86, anchor bottom, offset.y = the foot height in the straw (0 .. 0.30 in steps of 0.05) plus the lift a lean needs. The same layout (two of them, spun by a different angle per tube) serves every arrow kind.
straw: each tube holds a straw bed 0.10 under its rim; the surface is part of the frame with each triangle any arrow of any ripped model touches cut away.

heads.why: as fletcher_r2: Align.Axes turns the item's +long axis to up and the models differ in sign; the ValheimArmory arrows and ArrowNeedle are unripped, their head direction is not known.

items.arrow_size: fitted to 0.86 m like fletcher_r2 (an arrow item is 1.63-1.84 m in the game, 0.47x flint)

not_checked.VAArrowBone/VAarrow_surtling_fire/VAArro: ValheimArmory asset bundles, not ripped; the renders use stand-ins {"ArrowNeedle": "ArrowWood", "VAArrowBone": "ArrowFlint", "VAarrow_surtling_fire": "ArrowFire", "VAArrowGreenMetal": "ArrowPoison", "VAChitinArrow": "ArrowCarapace", "VAArrowAncient": "ArrowSilver"}

layout.density: 52 arrows of 0.86 m do not fit a tube of inner radius 0.123 without touching: packed mesh against mesh with no touching at all, fletcher_r2's rule, 7 fit at this radius and 20 at r2's barrel radius 0.19 (measured, all 11 models at once). So the bundles interleave like real ones: no arrow touches the frame, a tube or the straw (0, checked); arrows of one bundle touch each other (the layouts count the visible fletching and head contacts above the straw, 'layouts'; checks.per_model counts every triangle pair incl. shafts).

checks.method: mesh against mesh (BVH): every copy of every ripped arrow model against the frame and every other copy in its tube; the full fill also across tubes.
